items.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.title_zh: OpenAI 困惑度与智能文章引发评估指标争论
items.title_en: OpenAI essay links perplexity to intelligence, sparking metrics debate
items.summary: An OpenAI piece arguing that perplexity—equivalently, prediction/compression performance—is a core measurable correlate of intelligence, prompting HN discussion on its definition, its theoretical grounding in compression-as-world-modeling, and whether it still matters in the era of RL-trained reasoning models.

items.title: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028
items.title_zh: 分析称Anthropic 2028年电力结构为87%天然气、11%煤炭
items.title_en: Analysis: Anthropic's 2028 power mix projected at 87% gas, 11% coal
items.summary: An analysis showing that Anthropic's projected 2028 power supply is overwhelmingly fossil-based (87% gas, 11% coal), sparking a large HN debate on AI data-center energy demand, local pollution, and the need for regulation.

items.title: 美商务部将定稿规则，封堵中国 AI 公司远程用芯，管制扩展至新加坡等东南亚国家  美国商务部正敲定一项规则，阻止中国 AI 公司通过境外数据中心远程使用先进 A
items.title_zh: 美商务部将定稿新规，封堵中国 AI 公司远程使用先进芯片的漏洞
items.title_en: US Commerce Dept to finalize rule closing remote chip access loophole for Chinese AI firms
items.summary: The US Commerce Department is reportedly finalizing a rule to block Chinese AI companies from remotely accessing advanced AI chips via overseas data centers, extending semiconductor export controls to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and four other countries.
